extracted.intended_audience: Deputy Directors and senior managers at the CIA responsible for implementing OMB Circular A-44 and agency management improvements
extracted.subtask_description: Internal agency implementation of OMB Circular A-44: establish and operate a Management Improvement Program per agency instructions, designate points of contact, collect and submit required OMB reporting data, and focus reviews on reducing overhead and improving efficiency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comply with spirit and principles of OMB Circular A-44
rubrics_metrics.description: The President has given the program his personal endorsement and expects the support of key officials of all agencies in complying with the spirit and principles of the OMB directive.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Agency actions should reflect not only literal compliance but also the intent of OMB A-44 to improve management and efficiency across government operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Establish an effective Management Improvement Program
rubrics_metrics.description: Each Deputy Director should take immediate steps to establish an effective management improvement program in accordance with Agency instructions set forth in Attachment B.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Immediate action is required; programs must follow the Agency-specific instructions provided in Attachment B. Implementation should be organized at the Deputy Director level.

rubrics_metrics.name: Designate a senior officer as agency contact point by specified date
rubrics_metrics.description: Each Deputy Director is asked to designate, by 10 November, a senior officer as a contact point for him on these matters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Designations must be timely (by 10 November). The designated officer will act as the focal point for implementation communications and coordination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Central coordination and assembly of OMB reporting data
rubrics_metrics.description: The Director of Planning, Programming, and Budgeting is responsible for coordinating the Agency-wide management improvement program and assembling the reporting data required by OMB.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All offices must provide necessary data to the Director of PPB for consolidation. Coordination duties include collecting standardized reporting information required by OMB.

rubrics_metrics.name: Focus reviews on 'overhead' activities (substantive and administrative)
rubrics_metrics.description: Give attention to all so-called 'overhead' activities -- substantive as well as administrative -- to assure that staff review and coordination procedures and processes, as well as services provided, make a necessary contribution to our substantive missions and are performed as efficiently and economically as possible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examine both administrative and substantive overhead for opportunity to increase efficiency and reduce costs; evaluate whether procedures, coordination, and services are necessary and economical. Emphasize measurable cost-reduction and efficiency gains.

rubrics_metrics.name: Meet initial report deadlines and submission routing
rubrics_metrics.description: The initial report, as called for in Section IX of the Agency's Implementation Instructions, is due in O/PPB on 31 December 1970; it should be submitted to the Chief, DD/S Plans Staff no later than 21 December 1970.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Observe the internal routing: submit to Chief, DD/S Plans Staff by 21 December so O/PPB can receive by 31 December. Prepare reports according to Section IX requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submit documents in duplicate
rubrics_metrics.description: Submittals to the undersigned should be in duplicate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All formal submissions related to implementation should include two copies unless otherwise directed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use designated agency representatives for program setup
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific officials are designated as the O/PPB representative for the Agency in setting up a Management Improvement Program and as representatives for directorates (e.g., Director of Training designated as O/PPB representative).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow designated staffing assignments for program setup and directorate representation; coordinate through those representatives for program establishment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow Agency Implementation Instructions (Attachment B) and further instructions
rubrics_metrics.description: Implementation must be carried out 'in accordance with Agency instructions set forth in Attachment B' and additional Implementation Instructions will be forwarded as developed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attachment B contains the detailed agency procedures; expect further implementing guidance and incorporate updates as issued.
